headline: DATA Retires Proprietary Blockchain for Sui in $30 Million Deal
summary: The a16z-backed startup DATA is retiring its own blockchain and migrating to Sui with a $30 million investment to narrow its focus on AI training data.
why: Venture-backed blockchain startups frequently realign their infrastructure partnerships to optimize data processing capabilities for artificial intelligence.

impacts.name: Cryptocurrency Infrastructure
impacts.why: Strategic migration between layer-1 protocols affects ecosystem adoption rates.
